notes.title: Version update in September
notes.content:
This update:


1. Added 5 leaders and 10 monsters to make the battle more strategic.

2. The holy object system is added. You can obtain holy objects after completing the challenge in the battle. Holy objects are disposable consumables to help you solve emergencies.

3. The game story has been added. Now you can see the story behind the game.

4. A large number of equipment with different mechanisms have been added, and everyone can build various strategies in the battle.

zerogame

notes.title: New version update on July
notes.content:
Hello everyone!We have a new version to update, thanks to playing.	
	
        Update content:	
	     We have produced a large number of different level rewards to enrich the playing methods of roguelike.
	      New novice guidance function is added, so that players who have not been in contact with warchess game can smoothly understand the interest of the game strategy.
	
        Future update notice:	
	       We are making a story about the game world. It will meet you in next update.
	       We are making more monsters that affect game strategy.
	       More hero skill, equipment, hallows and so on. It will be more than twice the content of the current game.
	       Nwe game scene is making!


           zerogame
